sheru: Sheru Bhai: an anthropomorphic lion with a large golden mane, amber eyes, wearing a crisp white three-piece suit, gold tie and a gold wristwatch. Calm, confident, slightly amused. He must look exactly the same in every shot.
sheru_disguised: Sheru Bhai in disguise: the same anthropomorphic lion with a large golden mane and amber eyes, but wearing an old torn brown shawl over a faded kurta and worn sandals, looking humble.

rival.name: Gainda Seth
rival.look: Gainda Seth: an anthropomorphic grey rhino in a tight black suit, red tie and dark sunglasses, sweaty and over-confident. He must look exactly the same in every shot.

helper: Chhotu: a small kind white rabbit tea-seller in a simple apron, carrying a kettle and clay cups.
auction_setting: A grand luxury auction hall with white marble floors, golden chandeliers and a cheering crowd of well-dressed animals. An owl auctioneer in a waistcoat stands at a wooden podium with a hammer.
showroom_setting: A glittering luxury showroom with glass walls, marble floors and spotlights, with a small roadside tea stall just outside the entrance.
